## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 128 captures during April 2025. Activity was completed through the planned session arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. Overall capture activity was maintained across the reporting period, providing a consistent basis for image assessment and grading.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for review. A total of 5 captures were marked ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 3.9. These images could not be assessed for grading and should be considered when reviewing capture technique and local operating arrangements. Continued attention to image acquisition and camera positioning may help reduce the number of ungradable images in subsequent reporting periods.

## Grading

Grading identified 24 referable results from the captures completed at the site. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This indicates that grading was completed within the expected operational workflow for most activity. The site should continue to monitor both image quality and grading turnaround, with particular attention to ungradable captures and the timely handling of referable results.
